newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains up on sterling, short supply.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains up on sterling, short supply.

text.p: A shortage of physical market supply combined with the effect of an easier sterling to push LIFFE grains futures up, traders said.
May wheat last traded 0.95 sterling up at 96.20 stg.
Its high of one stg up on May was "a bit of a surprise," one said.
It demonstrated potential buyers' willingness to buy in the face of a shortage of sellers. "No one's releasing anything out in the field," he said.
However, overall volume was quite healthy, he said. There were 738 lots of wheat traded, of which 492 were on May.
The main effect of sterling had come in the morning, the trader said.
Barley also rose, with just 5 lost, all on March, traded. It last changed hands 0.75 stg up at 93.00 stg.
